schedule.meaning: A user-chosen computational scheduling metaphor; not biological REM or a performance guarantee
schedule.execution: No background runtime in these repositories. The planner returns deterministic phase windows.

protocols.focus: unbounded reference-palace ideation, counterfactual synthesis, post-wake candidate extraction, provenance
adversarial contradiction hunting, outlier exploration, two-brain counter-review, no identity fusion
Janus/A2A handoff, receipts and eval packaging
20 archived experimental dream-spec artifacts (each must be checked against its receipt)
research on work/play/pause/hibernate states and the 8/8/8 concept; efficiency multipliers are unverified project claims

rules: Novel dream associations are not constrained to memory replay; ideation may explore hypothetical worlds.
Compute, storage and token budgets remain bounded and opt-in.
No agent can self-promote a dream to canon, commit to repo, or execute tools from a dream.
Every wake report must distinguish observed data, simulation, source-dependent ideas and speculation.
Unresolved contradictions are preserved, not merged away.
